findings.issue_summary: **Silent Background Transfer**: Policy violation. Data is sent without prior disclosure.
findings.evidence: app/src/main/java/com/musically/studio/MyApplication.kt:30 unconditionally initializes CrashlyticsTree() in onCreate(), transferring performance diagnostics before the WelcomeScreen consent dialog can act as a gatekeeper.
findings.recommendation: Delay the initialization of Crashlytics and other telemetry SDKs until after the user has explicitly accepted the Privacy Policy in the WelcomeScreen.

findings.issue_summary: **User-Initiated Collection**: Disclosure exempt, but **must be declared** in Play Store form.
findings.evidence: app/src/main/java/com/musically/studio/MainActivity.kt:238 and CredentialVerifier.ts collect and send the user's name to the first-party backend during the user-initiated sign-in flow.
findings.recommendation: Declare the collection of Name data in the Play Store Data Safety form as a user-initiated collection.

findings.evidence: The CAMERA permission is requested in MainActivity.kt to capture live video frames for AI music generation, but there is no evidence of collecting or transferring static 'Photos'. This is a false positive.
findings.recommendation: No action required for Photos. Ensure that Camera usage is separately declared if video data is transferred.
